capabilities: Create bundle documents from the file menu and convert existing notes into bundle folders
Save pasted and dropped files into the active bundle's assets/ folder
Insert portable relative Markdown links like ./assets/sketch.png
Migrate existing local attachment links into the bundle and rewrite the note
Keep bundle folder renames in sync with the main Markdown file and mark bundles in the Files pane
disambiguation: Not an export or archive tool; it stores each note's local assets in an adjacent assets/ folder inside the vault.
extras: The marketplace listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README documents limitations: the file-explorer enhancement depends on Obsidian's DOM structure and link migration only rewrites links it can safely resolve.
motivation: The author wanted Notion's low-friction feeling, where dropped files simply belong to the page, while keeping plain, portable Markdown files.
problem: Obsidian stores attachments in vault-wide folders, so files pasted or dropped into a note get separated from it and require folder housekeeping.

relations.evidence: A Notion-style attachment experience for Obsidian, without giving up plain Markdown files.

summary: Bundle-style notes plugin that keeps each Markdown note's images, PDFs and other attachments in a same-named folder with an assets/ subfolder.
